verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no vendor-published acceptable-use policy, terms of service, or anti-abuse statement governing stealth/captcha-bypass or automation features; in fact a community comment accuses Notte of enabling robots.txt violations and captcha evasion with no visible rebuttal or policy citation from the vendor. Missing for 10: any acceptable-use policy page, anti-abuse statement, or terms-of-service excerpt addressing permitted use of stealth/captcha-solving capabilities.
